en_title: A GTA 6 Location Was Teased by Rockstar All the Way Back in 2021 — And What's Inside Was Worth the Wait
cn_title: Rockstar早在2021年就预告了《GTA6》中的一处地点——而里面的内容值得等待
opus_summary: Rockstar于2021年推出的《GTA: San Andreas》重制版中出现了一张房屋照片，玩家猜测它来自《GTA6》，如今这一猜测得到证实。房屋位于Belville，玩家可以闯入车库，发现一处阴谋论者的藏身之所，墙上留有关于游戏世界及角色的各种笔记。

paragraphs.en: SPOILER WARNING: This article features details on a GTA 6 Easter egg. Although it won't ruin the game's story or anything like that, we recognize some people want to organically discover and find interesting things on their own. You've been warned!
paragraphs.cn: 剧透警告：本文包含《GTA6》中一个彩蛋的细节。虽然它不会破坏游戏剧情或造成类似影响，但我们知道有些人希望自然而然地自行发现有趣的东西。你已经收到警告了！

paragraphs.en: In 2021, Rockstar Games released the somewhat controversial remastered collection of the PS2 era GTA titles. It was... a mess, to say the least. However, one notable thing came from that collection, but fans weren't sure if it actually meant anything. There was a picture of a house in this new version of GTA: San Andreas that wasn't there in the original game, and it didn't look like a location from any other GTA game. Fans theorized this was actually our first look at GTA 6 ... and it turns out, they were right!
paragraphs.cn: 2021年，Rockstar推出了颇具争议的PS2时代《GTA》游戏重制合集。那简直……说得客气点，是一团糟。不过，这个合集中出现了一个值得注意的东西，但粉丝们不确定它是否真的有什么含义。这个新版《GTA: San Andreas》中有一张房屋的照片，原版游戏里并没有，而且它看起来也不像其他任何一款《GTA》游戏中的地点。粉丝们推测，这实际上是我们对《GTA6》的第一瞥……结果证明，他们猜对了！

paragraphs.en: The house is real. It's located in Leonard County, in the suburb of Belville (shoutout Jared from the GTA mapping community for discovering this). However, that's just the tip of the iceberg. If you approach the house's garage, you can actually break in. Upon entry, it becomes clear this is a lair for some kind of conspiracy theorist. These aren't just ordinary in-universe ramblings — they're from someone who believes they are in a video game.
paragraphs.cn: 这栋房子确实存在。它位于Leonard County的Belville郊区（感谢《GTA》地图绘制社区的Jared发现了这一点）。不过，这只是冰山一角。如果你走近这栋房子的车库，就可以破门而入。进去之后便会发现，这里是某个阴谋论者的巢穴。这些并不只是游戏世界中普通的胡言乱语——它们出自一个相信自己身处电子游戏中的人。

paragraphs.en: All credit goes to Jared from the GTA VI Mapping server.
paragraphs.cn: 所有功劳都归于《GTA VI》地图绘制服务器的Jared。

paragraphs.en: The house is located in Belville. (https://t.co/hWt1Koz3uz) https://t.co/t2ZsSRPQFI

Various notes and writings on the wall point out that they can't leave Lenoida at all. They tried to purchase a ticket to Los Santos and couldn't, nor could they drive out of the state, and instead are planning to get a boat to try and escape. They also noted that there are an extraordinary amount of doppelgangers in reference to NPCs, that there is nothing behind closed doors, their own neighbors can't enter their homes, and that people phase through walls or "glitch." There's also a graph that shows a comically large spike in violent crime and a bunch of 6s written all over the place, likely poking fun at some of the people who drove themselves mad theorizing about this very game.
paragraphs.cn: 墙上的各种便条和文字指出，这个人根本无法离开Lenoida。他们试图购买前往Los Santos的车票却没能买到，也无法开车离开这个州，于是计划弄一艘船来尝试逃走。他们还提到，有数量异常庞大的「分身」，指的是NPC；关着的门后面什么都没有；他们自己的邻居无法进入各自的家；人们会穿过墙壁或出现「故障」。墙上还有一张图表，显示暴力犯罪出现了大得滑稽的飙升，到处还写着许多数字6，这很可能是在取笑一些因对这款游戏进行推测而把自己逼疯的人。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps one of the most notable bits is that this conspiracy theorist has determined two people, who go by "J" (Jason) and "L" (Lucia), are immune to whatever problems they are experiencing, suggesting they have freedom and autonomy. Ironically, they may have the least amount of autonomy, though, since they are controlled by the player, but they respawn, are largely free of longterm legal consequences, and can cause tons of mayhem, so they're less restricted than NPCs.
paragraphs.cn: 也许最值得注意的一点是，这位阴谋论者认定，自称「J」（Jason）和「L」（Lucia）的两个人不受他们所经历的那些问题影响，表明两人拥有自由和自主权。不过，讽刺的是，他们可能是自主权最少的人，因为他们受玩家控制；但他们可以重生，基本不必承担长期的法律后果，还能制造大量混乱，因此他们受到的限制比NPC少。

paragraphs.en: It's a very silly Easter egg, and one that leans into the absurdity of the GTA community in many ways. It's unclear whether this house was always meant to be like this, or if someone at the studio decided to have some fun with it after they saw how mad it drove fans. Either way, it gave me a good chuckle.
paragraphs.cn: 这是一个非常搞怪的彩蛋，在许多方面都迎合了《GTA》社区的荒诞之处。目前尚不清楚这栋房子是否从一开始就打算设计成这样，还是工作室的某个人在看到它让粉丝们多么疯狂后，决定借此找点乐子。无论如何，它让我开怀一笑。

paragraphs.en: In related news, GTA 6 is already shattering all kinds of records despite not being out globally. The game is driving tons of traffic to Twitch, YouTube, and Kick, with millions of people just watching the game. As for its critical reception, GTA 6 got a 10/10 from IGN and its critical praise has been echoed across the industry. In addition to being nominated for Game of the Year , GTA 6 is currently tied with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time as the highest rated game of all-time on Metacritic . While its position could change as more reviews trickle in over the next few weeks, it's clear this game is a gargantuan hit (though that likely isn't surprising).
paragraphs.cn: 在相关新闻中，尽管《GTA6》尚未在全球发售，它已经打破了各种纪录。这款游戏为Twitch、YouTube和Kick带来了大量流量，数百万人仅仅是在观看这款游戏。至于媒体评价，《GTA6》从IGN获得了10/10分，业内也纷纷给予好评。除了获得年度游戏提名，《GTA6》目前还与《塞尔达传说 时之笛》并列为Metacritic上有史以来评分最高的游戏。虽然随着未来几周更多评测陆续出现，它的排名可能会发生变化，但显然这款游戏取得了巨大的成功（尽管这或许并不令人意外）。
